title: Relative Clauses & Comparatives
description: Defining people and things with the relative pronouns who, which and that (subject), joining two sentences with them, comparatives (-er than / more … than) and their spelling, superlatives (the -est / the most), and equality with as + adjective + as and as much / many + noun + as
